metas.name: 1 · ★ 4.5 · 2021 · Space Jam: A New Legacy
metas.description: A rogue artificial intelligence kidnaps the son of famed basketball player LeBron James, who then has to work with the Looney Tunes to win a basketball game.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 4.5 · 2021 · Teen Titans Go! See Space Jam
metas.description: The Teen Titans are visited by the Nerdlucks, the iconic Space Jam (1996) villains. Astonished to discover his fellow Titans have never seen the movie, Cyborg organizes an exclusive watch party.
